title: GOLIATH HAD BROTHERS
subtitle: the giants David couldn't fight alone

lines.say: [excited] One stone. One giant. [shouting] BOOM!
[amused] Then why did David pick up five?
cap: Then why did David pick up {g:five}?

lines.say: [confused] ...Wait. Why FIVE?
[mischievously] [whispers] Maybe because Goliath... had brothers.
[shocked] [shouting] BROTHERS?!
[storytelling] You know the story. A shepherd boy. A sling.
[dramatically] One stone... and the giant fell.
[ominous] But he was NOT the last giant.
cap: But he was {r:NOT} the last giant.

lines.say: [softly] Years later, David was king. Older. Slower. Tired.
[ominous] And the Philistines came back... with a new giant.
/ˈɪʃbaɪ ˈbiːnɒb/.
[intense] His spearhead alone weighed as much as a newborn baby. And he came to kill David.
cap: His spearhead alone weighed as much as a {o:newborn baby}.

lines.say: [nervous laugh] It's fine. It's FINE. David's the giant killer!
[sadly] He was. [pause] But in the middle of the battle... David grew faint.
cap: But in the middle of the battle...

lines.say: [tense] [whispers] The giant raised his spear...
[panicked] [shouting] NO NO NO NO!
[excited] Then ABISHAI charged in... and struck the giant down!
[quietly] That day, David's men made him swear:
cap: That day, David's men made him swear:

lines.say: [firmly] [emotional] You will never go out to battle with us again... so that the lamp of Israel is never put out.
cap: “You will never go out to battle with us again...
so that the {g:lamp of Israel} is never put out.”

lines.say: [building] But the giants kept coming.
Saph. Taken down by /ˈsɪbəkaɪ/.
Goliath's own brother. Taken down by /ɛlˈheɪnən/.
[ominous] And at Gath... the strangest giant of all.
[slowly] Six fingers on each hand. Six toes on each foot.
[counting, amazed] That's... TWENTY-FOUR?!
[intense] He mocked Israel, just like Goliath had. And David's nephew Jonathan took him down.
cap: He mocked Israel, just like Goliath had.
And David's nephew {g:Jonathan} took him down.

lines.say: [slowly] Four giants. All from the same family in Gath.
cap: All from the same family in Gath.

lines.say: [warmly] And not one of them fell to David alone.
cap: And not one of them fell to David {g:alone}.

lines.say: [softly] So the boy who beat a giant by himself...
cap: So the boy who beat a giant by himself...

lines.say: [warmly] ...grew into a king who needed his friends.
cap: ...grew into a king who needed his {g:friends}.

lines.say: [thinking] ...So who's MY Abishai?
[dryly] Who carried you all the way out here?
cap: Who carried you all the way out here?

lines.say: [giggles] You're the SLOWEST Abishai ever.
[warmly] [chuckles] Still here, though.
[mischievously] Okay... ONE more time!
